english.note: Choose this when the resistance is framed as confronting or fighting an opposing side.
Use this for fiercely counteracting an opponent, problem, or social evil rather than having a physical fight.
Use this when opposing an adversary or force in a direct contest or confrontation.
Use this when the struggle is directed against an opponent, force, or fate.
